description: World - Electricity generation by country/area (GWh) by Country/area, Technology, Grid connection and Year 2019-2010 is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand, Renewable energy", published or maintained by IRENA (International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)). Data and statistics are used to monitor and evaluate renewable energy policies and deployment. IRENA provides analysts, policy makers and the public with access to up-to-date renewable energy data. IRENA publishes detailed statistics on renewable energy capacity, power generation and renewable energy balances. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Energy demand, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
